original_claim: For 1-free F subset C([8],4), |F|<=17, with equality iff F={A:|A∩S|>=3} for some 4-set S; pair-star and K6-clique have size 15; ordinary (i,j)-shifting need not preserve 1-freeness.

correctness.evidence: Independent compatibility-graph maximum-clique search found global maximum 17 (1144 nodes); exhaustive target-size search with 1234 fixed found exactly 17 maxima (425 nodes), all balls. Three orbit-case pools 36/42/40 and full 53-vertex pool were also checked with no 18-family.

originality.evidence: Frankl-Furedi 1985 and Frankl 1977 require sufficiently large n; Complete Intersection Theorem covers the narrower >=2-intersecting class. No checked source states the exact n=8,k=4 maximum 17 plus unique-ball classification.

value.evidence: Exact correction of the false 15 target, unique extremal classification in a larger class than 2-intersecting families, and reusable shifting counterexample.
